summary: Jeffrey Hopkins (1940–2024) was a scholar in Tibetology and Buddhist studies. He studied under Geshe Wangyal, Geshe Lhundub Sopa, Geshe Gelden, and earned a Ph.D. from the University of Wisconsin-Madison (~1968–1972). He served at the University of Virginia (1973–2024).

Jeffrey J. Kripal specializes in religious studies and Indology. He studied at Conception Seminary College (~1985–1989) and the University of Chicago (~1989–1993, PhD). In ~2002, he was Lynette S. Autrey Associate Professor in the Humanities at Rice University.
Sinologist Jeffrey K. Riegel held posts as Professor of Chinese at the University of California, Berkeley (~1982–2007) and at the University of Sydney (~2007–2017).

Jeffrey Kotyk works in Buddhist studies, Sinology, and religious studies. He studied at Komazawa University (MA 2015–2016), under Terry Russell, and completed a PhD at Leiden University (to 2017) under James A. Benn. He held posts at McMaster and Bologna.

Jeffrey L. Broughton is a scholar of Buddhist studies and Sinology. He completed a PhD at Columbia University (~1968–1975) and served as a professor in the Department of Religious Studies at California State University (~1980).

Jeffrey Mehlman is a scholar of philosophy. He held academic posts at Cornell University (~1968–1974), Johns Hopkins University (~1974–1983), Boston University (~1983), UC Berkeley, Harvard University, and Washington University in St. Louis.

Jeffrey Moussaieff Masson is a scholar of Indology and philosophy who studied at Harvard University (~1964–1970). He held posts at the University of Toronto (~1969–1980), UC Berkeley (~1977–1980 as Professor of Sanskrit), and the University of Michigan.

Jeffrey S. Lidke is a scholar in religious studies and Indology. He has held academic posts at Berry College and at the University of Virginia, where he was attested in 2003 as visiting assistant professor of religion.

Jeffrey Samuels specializes in Buddhist and religious studies. He studied under W. S. Karunatillake and earned his PhD at the University of Virginia under Karen C. Lang. In 2013, he was Associate Professor of Religious Studies at Western Kentucky University.

Jeffrey Stout is a scholar of philosophy and religious studies. He studied at Brown University (~1968–1972), Princeton University (~1972–1977), and California Culinary Academy (~1993–1994). He served on the Princeton University faculty from ~1975, becoming Professor (~1988–2018).

Jeffrey Wayne Bass works in Buddhist and religious studies. He studied at UNC Wilmington (BA), UT (MA), and UCLA (PhD) under Gregory Schopen, James L. Fitzgerald, and William M. Bodiford. He held teaching posts at UCLA and UC San Diego.

Jenkuan Shih is a Buddhist studies scholar who earned a PhD at the University of Wisconsin-Madison (attested 2006). Shih studied under Geshe Lhundub Sopa, Charles Hallisey, Mark Csikszentmihalyi, and Gudrun Bühnemann.

Jens Braarvig is a scholar in Buddhist studies, Tibetology, and Indology. He held posts as professor at the University of Oslo (2003) and at the Norwegian Institute of Palaeography and Historical Philology (attested 2004).

Jens Schlieter specializes in religious studies, Tibetology, and Buddhist studies. He studied at the University of Bonn (~1987–1999) and the University of Vienna, and became Professor and Institute Managing Director at the University of Bern (~2009).

Jens-Uwe Hartmann studied at Munich, Göttingen, and Hamburg under Lambert Schmithausen. A scholar of Indology, Buddhist studies, and Tibetology, he held posts at Göttingen (~1984–1995), Free University of Berlin (~1995–1997), Humboldt University (~1995–2001), and Munich (1999, 2001).

Jeong-Eun Kim is a scholar in history, archaeology, and Buddhist studies. Kim earned a PhD from SOAS University of London (to 2011), studying under doctoral supervisor Youngsook Pak and teacher Rosemary Smith.

Jerome Silbergeld is a scholar in Sinology, history, and archaeology. He studied at the University of Oregon (~1962–1966) and Stanford University (~1969–1974), and held a post at Princeton University (~2001–2016).

Jerzy Bańczerowski (1938–2026) was a linguist who studied at Adam Mickiewicz University in Poznań (~1956–1961). He held an academic post there from ~1961 to 2008, serving as Professor from ~1983 to 2008.

Jessie Pons is a scholar of Buddhist studies, history, archaeology, and religious studies. She completed a doctoral thesis at Paris-Sorbonne University (-2011) and was Junior Professor in South Asian History of Religion at Ruhr University Bochum (attested 2019).
Ji Hao is a Sinologist who earned a PhD at the University of Minnesota under doctoral supervisor Paul Rouzer. Hao held an academic post at the College of the Holy Cross (attested 2017).
